Front-end learning exercise.

An early HTML and CSS build

A small animal trading-card page built with semantic HTML and CSS.

HTML · CSS

The question

Practice turning a visual card concept into a structured web page.

The work

  • Structure the title, image, description and facts in HTML.
  • Apply CSS layout, spacing and visual hierarchy.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Public repository includes card.html, styles.css and image assets.

What I learned

  • Establish web-layout fundamentals that support later application work.

Project context

  • Archive-level learning artifact; not a flagship product case.
  • Third-party animal photography is not republished in this media pack.

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
